items.review_rationale: Read the alternate geometric-reducedness criterion using extension to the perfect closure. Linked the existing perfect-closure and reduced-ring meanings while retaining that scalar extension is a tensor product, not a field product.

references.context: Commutative algebra: algebra tensor extension of scalars from k to its perfect closure

references.disposition: The displayed perfect-closure criterion is a second characterization of the same geometric property, not a separate meaning.

items.review_rationale: Examined the full projectivity equivalence, separating projective modules, flat modules, Mittag-Leffler modules and the direct-sum condition, without confusing countable generation with finite generation.

references.phrase: direct sum of countably generated R-modules
references.context: Module theory: direct sums of countably generated modules over a ring

references.disposition: Both implications are part of the stated criterion; no replacement by countably presented or finitely generated modules is justified.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed finite ring homomorphism as a module-finiteness condition on S via the given scalar ring map, not as a finite-cardinality ring or a ring map of finite presentation.

references.disposition: Scalar multiplication by R on S uses the specified ring map rather than an arbitrary external action.

items.review_rationale: Read the entire local étaleness criterion at a target prime q, keeping g outside q, the localization S_g, and the étale condition on R to S_g, not on a general source-prime localization.

references.context: Commutative algebra: localization at multiplicative powers of a single element g

references.disposition: The localization element must avoid the target prime q; it is a local existence condition, not an assertion that q is maximal.
